title: Pakistan EPADS & PPRA Tender Notices Scraper input
description: Choose jurisdictions and filters. The Actor reads only publicly accessible procurement pages and does not log in or submit bids.

sources.title: Jurisdictions
sources.description: Federal includes both the EPADS 2.0 open-opportunities portal and the Federal PPRA public tender listing.

keywords.title: Include keywords
keywords.description: Match against title, description, reference, buyer, category, sector, and location. Leave empty to include every notice.

reference.title: Tender or reference number
reference.description: Optional partial or exact portal ID, tender number, inquiry number, or buyer reference.

description.title: Description contains
description.description: Optional phrase required in the long tender description. Keep Include details enabled so detail-only text can be checked.

matchAllKeywords.title: Require all include keywords
matchAllKeywords.description: When false, any include keyword can match. When true, every include keyword must match.

excludeKeywords.title: Exclude keywords
excludeKeywords.description: Discard a notice when any of these phrases appears in its searchable text.

organizations.title: Buyer or organization names
organizations.description: Optional partial-name filters such as Pakistan Army, Health Department, or WAPDA.

cities.title: Cities or locations
cities.description: Optional partial location filters such as Lahore, Karachi, Rawalpindi, Peshawar, Quetta, or Islamabad.

noticeTypes.title: Notice types
noticeTypes.description: Optional values such as Tender Notice, RFQ, RFP, EOI, Prequalification, Corrigendum, or Auction.

categories.title: Procurement categories
categories.description: Optional values such as Goods, Works, Non-Consultancy Services, Consultancy Services, Furniture, or Electrical Items.

activeOnly.title: Active notices only
activeOnly.description: Exclude notices explicitly marked closed, cancelled, archived, or with a past deadline.

publishedWithinHours.title: Published within the last N hours
publishedWithinHours.description: Use 24 for a daily new-tender scan. Use 0 to disable this relative-date filter.

publishedFrom.title: Published from
publishedFrom.description: Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD date. Leave blank for no lower limit.

publishedTo.title: Published to
publishedTo.description: Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD date. Leave blank for no upper limit.

deadlineFrom.title: Deadline from
deadlineFrom.description: Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD date. Leave blank for no lower limit.

deadlineTo.title: Deadline to
deadlineTo.description: Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD date. Leave blank for no upper limit.

minimumRemainingHours.title: Minimum time before deadline
minimumRemainingHours.description: Use 48 to exclude opportunities with less than 48 hours remaining. Use 0 to disable.

onlyNew.title: Return only new or changed notices
onlyNew.description: Remember notices between scheduled runs. A changed deadline, status, title, or document set is emitted again as an update.

stateStoreName.title: Monitoring state store name
stateStoreName.description: Use a different name for each independent monitoring task.

seenRetentionDays.title: Monitoring history retention
seenRetentionDays.description: Forget state records older than this many days.

includeDetails.title: Open tender detail pages
includeDetails.description: Extract descriptions, contacts, bid security, validity, procedure, and other fields when public detail pages exist.

includeDocumentLinks.title: Collect public document links
includeDocumentLinks.description: Collect advertisements, bidding documents, corrigenda, and embedded EPADS bidding-document links.

maxItems.title: Maximum notices
maxItems.description: Maximum normalized tender records saved to the dataset after filtering and deduplication.

maxPagesPerSource.title: Maximum listing pages per portal
maxPagesPerSource.description: Safety limit for each public portal. EPADS 2.0 currently serves many opportunities on one page.

maxDetailPages.title: Maximum detail pages
maxDetailPages.description: Cost guardrail across all portals. Text filters that only appear inside a notice description can only be evaluated for detail pages visited within this limit.

maxConcurrency.title: Maximum browser concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Maximum number of portal requests processed concurrently. Reduce this value if a government portal throttles or times out.

maxRequestRetries.title: Request retries
maxRequestRetries.description: Number of automatic retries after a temporary portal, network, or timeout failure.

requestTimeoutSecs.title: Request timeout in seconds
requestTimeoutSecs.description: Maximum time allowed for one portal request before it is treated as timed out.

sortField.title: Sort results by
sortField.description: Relevance prioritizes keyword matches; other options mirror common tender-search ordering.

sortAscending.title: Sort ascending
sortAscending.description: Enable for earliest deadline/oldest publication/A-Z. Disable for highest relevance/latest publication/Z-A.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. A Pakistan or residential proxy can help when a provincial portal rejects cloud traffic.
